designationHistory.name: Valentine Migratory Waterfowl Refuge
designationHistory.indexText: President Franklin D. Roosevelt established the Valentine Migratory Waterfowl Refuge by Executive Order 7142 on August 14, 1935 in the Nebraska Sandhills, and it was renamed Valentine National Wildlife Refuge in 1940.
designationHistory.note: Pass A (1999 CCP: "established on August 14, 1935, by Executive Order No. 7142") and Pass B (order text on the American Presidency Project) agree. The fws.gov page says "established by Congress in 1935"; that is wrong, the refuge was established by executive order. Renamed Valentine National Wildlife Refuge by Proclamation 2416, July 25, 1940.

sources.name: FWS, Valentine NWR Comprehensive Conservation Plan (1999), refuge history
